environment.description: Same application on ECS Fargate in a private subnet. An S3 Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) is attached to the route table with a custom endpoint policy. The endpoint policy contains a Condition block with StringEquals on 's3:prefix' limiting operations to keys matching 'encrypted/${aws:PrincipalTag/team}/*' and a Condition 'aws:PrincipalOrgID' restricting to the organization. Additionally, the endpoint policy has an explicit Deny for any PutObject request where 'x-amz-server-side-encryption' header is absent (enforcing SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS). The route table has no NAT gateway route for S3 prefix list, forcing all S3 traffic through the VPC endpoint. The task role has a permission boundary that denies s3:GetObject unless aws:ResourceTag/classification equals 'authorized-decrypt'.

config.network: Private subnet, no NAT route for S3 prefix list (pl-63a5400a)
config.s3_bucket_tags: Objects in prod-documents-enc have classification=authorized-decrypt only on keys matching encrypted/*/finalized/*
